localContext: The Reno-Sparks area and the Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center in Storey County host battery manufacturing, data centre campuses, large distribution operations and materials recycling, while northern Nevada's gold mines, new lithium projects and geothermal power plants add heavy-industry work. Technicians inspect structural steel, process and geothermal piping, pressure equipment and mining machinery to AWS D1.1 and ASME practice, so VT, MT, PT and UT dominate.
certPathwayNote: Employers certify under a written practice based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A: training hours, logged experience, general, specific and practical examinations, a vision test, then employer certification. Plants owned by national companies sometimes import a written practice from another state, which a Level III then reconciles with local work. Nevada radiography needs state radiation licensing, separate from method certification.
